📢 IPA: /ˈθɜːr.ə.li/ (US)
🧩 Syllable by Syllable:
  • thor — soft "th" (tongue between the teeth, like think) + a vowel like "her"
  • ough → a quick, unstressed "uh" (schwa)
  • ly — like "lee"
💡 Pronunciation Tips:
  • Mandarin speakers: the θ ("th") has no Mandarin equivalent — put the tongue tip lightly between the teeth and blow; don't substitute "s" or "f".
  • Stress the first syllable: THOR-ough-ly. It's 3 syllables, not 4.
✍️ Spelling Tips:
  • The tricky part is -ough- (silent, said "uh"): thor-ough-ly. Same ough letters as in though.
🔁 Memory Hook: "THOR-oughly" — picture Thor doing something thoroughly. 🔨
